description: Durable local-first MCP relay for independent coding agents.
name: io.github.constripacity/claude-code-bridge

environmentVariables.description: SQLite database path (default: ./claude-bridge.db). Share the same path across HTTP and stdio instances to share state.
environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_DB

environmentVariables.description: Optional Bearer token for HTTP mode. As of 1.2.0, binding a non-loopback host requires this token together with an explicit trusted host (CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TRUSTED_HOSTS), unless --allow-unauthenticated-network is passed; loopback (stdio and localhost) does not require it. When set, all HTTP endpoints except /status require Authorization: Bearer <token>. Not used in stdio mode.
environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_AUTH_TOKEN

title: Claude Bridge
